## Example launch.json

Below is an example `launch.json` debug configuration entry for `lldb`:

```json
"configurations": [
    {
        "name": "Launch (lldb)",
        "type": "cppdbg",
        "request": "launch",
        "program": "${workspaceFolder}/a.out",
        "args": [],
        "stopAtEntry": false,
        "cwd": "${workspaceFolder}",
        "environment": [],
        "externalConsole": false
    }
]
```
